{
  "verdict": "APPROVED",
  "summary": "The implementation of the 4-timeframe multi-period analysis, conditional advice system, and layout restructuring strictly follows the B76 plan. The migration logic for timeframe selection ensures backward compatibility with the legacy 'wv_mode' storage. XSS protection is consistently applied via the 'esc' helper for all dynamic data, and the multi-timeframe mapping accurately addresses the new snapshot keys (m30, ultra, short, swing).",
  "findings": [],
  "coverage": "Complete inspection of regime-frontend/wave.js and regime-frontend/index.html against PLAN-B76. Verified logic for timeframe switching, ladder rendering, margin last-10-days table, and advice engine UI.",
  "limitations": "The inspection is limited to the frontend implementation; back-end logic for snapshot calculation (e.g., θ calibration for 30m K and the rule-based advice engine) is assumed to match the documented PLAN-B76 specifications."
}

parsed.summary: The implementation of the 4-timeframe multi-period analysis, conditional advice system, and layout restructuring strictly follows the B76 plan. The migration logic for timeframe selection ensures backward compatibility with the legacy 'wv_mode' storage. XSS protection is consistently applied via the 'esc' helper for all dynamic data, and the multi-timeframe mapping accurately addresses the new snapshot keys (m30, ultra, short, swing).
parsed.coverage: Complete inspection of regime-frontend/wave.js and regime-frontend/index.html against PLAN-B76. Verified logic for timeframe switching, ladder rendering, margin last-10-days table, and advice engine UI.
parsed.limitations: The inspection is limited to the frontend implementation; back-end logic for snapshot calculation (e.g., θ calibration for 30m K and the rule-based advice engine) is assumed to match the documented PLAN-B76 specifications.
